page.title: Vardath Kopis Production Cheat
page.t: Experimental Terran Kopis conversion: massive universal freight, Dart-like agility, a slowly self-producing economy cargo supply and nearby station build-storage logistics. Can carry building and cargo drones and 250 people. Its primary weapon is a 100-times-damage Terran Mk2-derived Forge laser. The experimental dorsal turret socket was removed; all logistics features remain.
Terran Mk2 laser derivative with 8,000 damage per hit (100 times the original 80).
Kopis Forge Beam Turret Mk1 X10
Custom Terran Meson Stream beam turret with 35,900 base beam damage, ten times the 3,590 original.
